name: skyc
description: Client-side media downloader app for Android, Windows, and CLI with a Claude-inspired theme.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:scrapers && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:dev: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.windows:dev: npm run build:scrapers && npx tauri dev
scripts.windows:build: npm run build:scrapers && npx tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
